10.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve retrofit kit, SV / DV valves become SCV
10.evidenceText: Multiple prices found across sources: €4.90, €5.99, €4.61, €7.55, €3.27, €6.04, €11.99, €9.99, €3.79, €9.99. Median of sorted prices: €6.02
10.extractionRationale: Extracted median price from all retail prices found across three German retailers. Prices include: ebike24.com (€4.90 sale, €5.99 regular), bike24.com (€4.61, €7.55, €3.27, €6.04), and bike-discount.de (€11.99, €9.99, €3.79, €9.99). Median calculated from 10 distinct price points.

27.evidenceText: Three distinct CoreCap product page URLs: p1993548, p1993551, and p1993547 (all BBB Cycling CoreCap AL Valve BTI-166). Two additional URLs (p1993581, p1993585) are valve cores/accessories (Ventilkern), not complete products.
27.extractionRationale: Counted unique product page URLs for CoreCap valves on bike24.de, excluding accessory components (valve cores). The three BTI-166 listings represent distinct product pages, while the BTI-165 entries are valve core accessories.

30.evidenceText: No stock status indicators found in any of the 4 product listing sources (40mm, 60mm, 80mm variants and brand overview page)
30.extractionRationale: Stock status cannot be determined from the provided text excerpts. None of the sources explicitly mention 'out of stock', 'currently unavailable', 'nicht verfügbar', 'ausverkauft', or similar terms. The provided content only shows navigation, ratings, and general store information.

36.evidenceText: The source page contains product installation instructions mentioning adapters and pump heads, but does not display e-commerce cross-sell sections like "frequently bought together" or "related products"
36.extractionRationale: The provided source is a product information page with technical instructions. It does not contain e-commerce listing data showing accessory attachment rates, frequently bought together sections, or related products recommendations. No quantitative data about attach rates could be extracted from this source.

37.evidenceText: SKU: [values not displayed in content]. The page shows placeholder sections for SKUs but actual values and counts are not provided in the accessible text.
37.extractionRationale: The source page contains references to SKUs but the actual SKU numbers and count of distinct replacement/spare parts are not populated in the provided content excerpt. No specific number of valve cores, seals, o-rings, or replacement kit SKUs can be extracted from the available evidence.

45.evidenceText: DT Swiss product pages for gravel and road wheelsets reviewed; no mention of Clik valve adoption in any product specifications or 2026-2027 product line information. Other major brands (Mavic, Hunt, Zipp, ENVE, Roval) not covered in provided sources.
45.extractionRationale: The provided evidence does not contain any information about Clik valve adoption by any major wheelset brands. The sources show current DT Swiss product pages but contain no specifications related to Clik valve or future product lines for 2026-2027. No data supporting the requested metric was found.

49.evidenceText: Sources reference 4 distinct bicycle models with Clik valve specifications: Bergamont Grandurance 10, Canyon Grizl CF 7, BULLS MACHETE RX 1, and Specialized Diverge 4. Each appears in 99spokes.com comparison pages with "Clik valve" listed in their specifications.
49.extractionRationale: Counted distinct bicycle models across the 5 provided sources from 99spokes.com that explicitly list "Clik valve" in their specifications. Bergamont Grandurance 10 appears in sources 1-3, Canyon Grizl CF 7 in sources 1-3, BULLS MACHETE RX 1 in sources 2-3, and Specialized Diverge 4 in sources 1 and 3. Sources 4 and 5 reference Presta valves, not Clik valves.

50.evidenceText: Found 2 distinct Clik valve technical/installation/FAQ pages: (1) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/clik-valve - dedicated Clik Valve product page with installation instructions, and (2) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/technology-faq/valve - FAQ page about bike tire valves covering Clik Valve functionality
50.extractionRationale: Counted unique URLs on schwalbe.com that are specifically dedicated to Clik valve technical documentation, installation guides, or FAQs. Excluded homepage and product pages for other items (tubes) that only mention Clik compatibility.

56.evidenceText: Schwalbe EXTRA LIGHT bicycle inner tube no. 12-EL, SCHWALBE EXTRA LIGHT TUBE 14-EL (27.5"), and Schwalbe AIR PLUS bicycle inner tube no. 7-AP are listed on the Clik Valve product page
56.extractionRationale: Source 1 from the Clik Valve page lists three distinct inner tube SKUs: 12-EL (26"), 14-EL (27.5"), and 7-AP (20"). These are the only specific inner tube models found in the evidence. Sources 2-5 discuss the Clik Valve technology, conversion kits, and adapters but do not list additional inner tube models.
